query: SELECT presence_narration.group_id, presence_narration.generation, max(0, unixepoch(due_at) - unixepoch('now')) AS "after_seconds?: i64" FROM presence_narration JOIN "group" ON "group".id = presence_narration.group_id WHERE "group".world_id = ? AND "group".retired_at IS NULL AND due_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY due_at, presence_narration.group_id LIMIT 1
